messages.content: [system prompt omitted to save space — identical rendering rules as run2-t0.5, prompt revision before the Sunday-hours sentence]
Hello, you've reached Sakura Say-koh-tsoo-in. This is the clinic's AI receptionist, speaking in English. How can I help you today?
I strained my lower back and the pain is intense. Can you see me today?

If this is an emergency, please hang up and call 119 for an ambulance right away. Otherwise, I can tell you that we're open today until seven in the evening. Appointments are recommended, but walk-ins may also be accepted depending on availability. Would you like me to help you arrange a callback with our staff?
No, it's not bad enough for an ambulance.
I'm glad to hear that. You can visit us today, and if you would like, I can take your details for a staff member to call you back and help arrange your visit. What would you like to do?
Got it, thank you very much.
